A vase? (\textbf{le vase}.) A plant? (\textbf{la plante}.) A seed? (\textbf{la graine}.) A root? (\textbf{la racine}.) A branch? (\textbf{la branche}.) Lightning? (\textbf{l'éclair}.) Thunder? (\textbf{le tonnerre}.) The climate? (\textbf{le climat}.) The environment? (\textbf{l'environnement}.) Pollution? (\textbf{la pollution}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

A dictionary? (\textbf{le dictionnaire}.) A university? (\textbf{l'université}.) A mistake? (\textbf{l'erreur}.) History? (\textbf{l'histoire}.)
